runner.source: Plain crimson wool runner on dark strip hardwood, the borders bare (film 10819, 2687, 2296, 10828, 410). Width: film 10819 at v 1040 the runner spans 0.61 of the floor between the walls (710 / 1160 px) -> 0.74 m in a 1.214 m hall; built 0.70 m (a stock 28 in runner), one fitted piece: x 5.86-6.56 in the vestibule (clear of the table, front x 6.591) and x 6.03-6.73 from the arch to the attic end (clear of the ficus by the rail and the urns and table on the +x walls), so it jogs 0.17 m under the first arch, where the film's runs straight (its hall is narrower): DEVIATIONS 63. Colour: runner / white wainscot in the same frame x 0.85, linear (0.19-0.26, 0.00-0.04, 0.04-0.07) over 10819/2687/2296/10828 -> (0.23, 0.01, 0.05). Gallery: film 2687 (from the stair top) shows the red carpet wide across the top of the stairs, from the balustrade to near the far wall: a rectangle over the gallery floor 13 cm off the rail line (z 9.16) and 4 cm off the stair's top edge (x 3.938).

Built with the crown at 2.30, 10 cm under our 2.40 ceiling (the film's set ceiling is ~2.6 m: the paper band above the crown reads ~0.17 m in 2085): a flatter arch than the film's (rise 0.26 vs 0.35), DEVIATIONS 64.
